viewport_draw.what: Starts the grease pencil so you can draw on top of the viewport for this note.
examples: Circle the elbow that pinches, then Capture.
Draw an arrow showing where the skin should go.

clear_viewport.what: Deletes every grease pencil drawing in the scene.
examples: Click it after the note is created.
Clear the old drawings before starting a new note.

capture_image.tip: Capture the viewport for the note.
capture_image.what: Takes a picture of the viewport (with or without the HUD) and attaches it to the note.
examples: Draw on the problem, click Capture, then Create Note.
Turn off ornaments to capture a clean picture.

create_note.what: Saves the note with its title, text, frame and captured image.
examples: Title "Elbow pinch", text "frame 24, needs more weight on the upper arm", Create Note.
Mark the note as urgent so it shows first.
